description: Promote staging to production (requires a paid plan): production's database migrates from the schema it runs to the one staging runs, and production runs staging's build. With staging unchanged since the last promotion, it rebuilds production with no schema change. The operation is ASYNCHRONOUS: poll the returned job_id with get_job_status. A plan that drops data is refused, naming every table, field, entity or relationship it would drop, and every field whose type change rounds or cuts its values (a decimal with a smaller scale or turned integer, a datetime turned date): deploy_destructive applies it, a tool of its own so a client asks before it runs. One operation runs on a project at a time: while another runs, the call is refused and the refusal names the running job; wait for it with get_job_status, then call again. While RationalBloks is being updated, the call is refused with 'RationalBloks is being updated': call it again in a few minutes.
name: deploy_production
title: Deploy to Production
